scope: The exterior of the National Museum of Taiwan Literature in Tainan in June 2025. Includes the former prefectural hall, paired copper-domed towers, two masonry wings, mansards and the attached rear museum volumes. The outdoor sculpture, surrounding buildings and museum interiors are outside this architectural scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Taiwan history museum describes the two-storey brick prefectural hall, paired cylindrical towers beside the entrance, copper mansards and oculus dormers.
The museum’s 2011 newsletter describes the original core and the 1920 wing additions, with gabled porches, keystone arches, flat-arched upper windows and two dormer types.
The restoration architect describes the restored mansards, towers and dormers, and the corridor between the historic red brick hall and the new rear building.
